Calindvale Gardens, Deetra Grotto, Eastern Solstice, Cave below Gristmung Hold, Mor Naril, Palace District, Sea and Sword Lodge, Near Warm-Stone Village Daedroth are a large reptilian Daedra. The common blue variety are associated with the Daedric Prince Molag Bal, while the green variety are associated with Mehrunes Dagon and can be found in the Deadlands and Apocrypha. They may sometimes be equipped with armor. Daedroth guard gateways within The Brimstone Den in Vateshran Hollows. Certain Daedroth in The Deadlands can be seen biting the head off of a banekin when approaching them.
